01 / How it works

How it works

If you can send a WhatsApp message, you can use Hustlr. There are no menus to learn.

Example chat
I need a plumber
Sure. Which area are you in, and when do you need someone?
Avondale, today if possible
I found plumbers who work around Avondale. Want me to book the first one for this afternoon?
Yes please
Done. They'll message you to confirm the time.
  1. 01

    Say what you need

    Type it the way you would tell a friend. “My geyser is leaking” works.

  2. 02

    Meet your match

    Hustlr asks a question or two, then suggests providers who fit the job and your area.

  3. 03

    Book it

    Pick one and Hustlr sets it up. The provider messages you to confirm the details.

03 / Good to know

Questions

The short answers. For anything else, ask in the chat.

Do I need to install anything?

No. If you have WhatsApp, you already have everything you need. Hustlr works entirely inside the chat.

What does it cost?

Asking Hustlr to find someone is free. You agree the price for the job directly with the provider before any work starts.

What happens to my details?

We only share your job, area and contact with the provider you choose, so they can confirm the booking. Read our privacy policy for the details. Privacy policy

Which services can I find?

Plumbers, electricians, cleaners and tutors across Zimbabwe, with more trades on the way. If you are not sure, just ask in the chat.
